record.question: Which of the following countries is the biggest arms supplier to India?
record.explanation: Answer A: Russia. Russia was India's largest supplier of major weapons in the period relevant to the June 2014 paper. SIPRI's original 2014 arms-transfer study attributes 75% of India's major-arms imports in 2009–13 to Russia, above the other printed suppliers. Historical/source note: Historical SIPRI volume-of-major-arms-deliveries measure for 2009–13; not a present-day ranking or the financial value of all defence trade. Reference: https://www.sipri.org/sites/default/files/SIPRIYB14c05sI.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
